news.headline: Packers sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite latest abuse allegations

news.headline: Cardinals' Mike LaFleur: Jeremiyah Love's injury to 'new portion' of his ankle

news.headline: Brandon Aiyuk hires Drew Rosenhaus as agent, eyes return to NFL
